text.en: Most clients describe the staff as caring, trustworthy, and welcoming, noting that groomers communicate clearly and calm nervous pets. However, two reviews cite negative encounters, including rude front desk interactions and a lack of follow-up after an interrupted grooming session.

Dog owners frequently praise the quality of haircuts, thorough coat brush-outs, and hand stripping for terriers and poodles. Dogs return smelling clean and looking well groomed. One client noted dissatisfaction after a grooming session was terminated early.

Reviewers note that groomers handle senior dogs, energetic rescue puppies, and nervous pets with patience and gentle reassurance. Multiple clients mention that their dogs enter the shop willingly and feel relaxed during routine nail trims and bath appointments.

q.en: Does the salon offer hand stripping?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that groomers provide specialized hand stripping services for terrier coats.

q.en: Can I bring my dog for a walk-in nail trim?

a.en: Yes, the salon accommodates walk-in nail trims during regular business hours.

q.en: How long does a full grooming appointment take?

a.en: Reviewers report that standard grooming sessions typically take between three and four hours.
